title: Maqtal E Imam Hussain AS
body:
Jab qatl run me hogyi Haye sepahe Shah
Aaye dare khayam pe rukhsat ko Dee panah,
Baaqi bachi thi dil me na jine ki koi chah ,
Dekha bahen ka chehra to dil se uthi ik aah,
Kunbe k gham me aankh bhigote hue chale,
Bacho ko dekh dekh k rote hue chale
Aa pohoche ashk poch k run me shahe huda
Aayi nazar jo door se phir nahre alqama
Aawaz di kahan ho mere shere bawafa,
Tanha h tera bhai sar-e dashte karbala,
Aye mere bawafa mere shere jari utho
Bhai ki jung dekhne mere akhi utho,
Haye , Ye bain krte aage badhe shahe haq shanas
Nagah dekha baap ne kadyal jawa’n ki lash,
Gham me pisar k hogya dil sheh ka pash pash,
Bole tadap k aayi na tumko zamee ye raas,
Tareek daher hogya akbar tumhare baad,
Hum ji k kya kre mere dilbar tumhare baad,
Ye kah rahe hi the ki hua waar gurz ka,
Ghode pe dagamane lage ibne murtuza,
Sambhle na the abhi ki chala naizaye jafa,
Tharra gye nazar me andhera sa chha gya,
Girne lage jo zee’n se to yalghar hogyi
Teero ki char samt se bauchhar hogyi,
Zeeno zamee'n k bich jo shabbeer aagye,
Bekas pe zulm dhane ko be peer aagye,
Le le k log naizao Shamsheer aagye
Deene khuda ki lootne jageer aagye,
Sheh k lahu se run ki zamee laal hogyi
Bekas ki lash ghodo se pamal hogyi,
Is zulm pe bhi na ruka shimre sitam sheaar,
Khanjar liye hue wo hua shah per sawar,
Krne laga gulooye shahe Deen pe jo war
Khanjar ki zarbato se hua sheh ka sir fegar
Ye dekh k kaleja payambar ka phat gaya
Godi me fatema k gala sheh ka kat gaya,
Suhail tabl bajne lage fauje sham me,
Ik Dhoom si machi thi sitam k khayam me,
Aaho buka thi khanaye shahe anam me,
Sir peetti thi bahen ghame tashnakam me,
Aye muntazir her aik madadgaar chhut gaye,
Bade husain khaimaye athar lut Gaye,
